join_radius_mm.basis: a site joins a link only within this distance of the link's running centroid; the smallest radius that reproduces the JL-to-K and JL-to-P counts and distances of reviews/da-03.md F4 (scanned at 25, 26, 30, 35 and 40 mm); F4 does not retain its own rule

cable.length_rule: needed = 2 x insertion + a + b + V + (pi - 4) x R, with a and b the plan distances from each connector opening to the slot centre and V = gap + K thickness (both ends enter at the same height below their board's rear face, ASSUMED)

fixing_keepout_radius_mm.status: SOURCED for the 18 posts (parameters.json post_resites.screen_keepout_radius_mm); ASSUMED equal for the 12 kept supports (reviews/da-03.md F8: 7.0 mm spacer inside the 3.75 mm radius; nut and washer on K's rear face)

latch_access_margin_mm.basis: a K-rear footprint within this margin of a K field and not displaced by it is listed as a latch-reach question; part heights there are not retained

distance_weight_per_mm.basis: cost = displaced footprints + weight x slot distance from the link centre

search.rule: links in a fixed order (joint, link id); for each, every slot centre on a square grid within the radius of the link centre and four directions of the cable (+x, -x, +y, -y); the legal candidate of least cost is kept and becomes an obstacle for later links; no backtracking
